mapper.select: SELECT FROM sql_task_schedule WHERE task_id=#{taskId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM sql_task_schedule WHERE enabled=1 AND schedule_type='CRON' AND next_trigger_time IS NOT NULL AND next_trigger_time<=#{now} ORDER BY next_trigger_time LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE sql_task_schedule SET schedule_type=#{schedule.scheduleType},cron_expression=#{schedule.cronExpression},timezone=#{schedule.timezone},enabled=#{schedule.enabled},concurrency_policy=#{schedule.concurrencyPolicy},max_retries=#{schedule.maxRetries},retry_interval_seconds=#{schedule.retryIntervalSeconds},parameter_values=#{schedule.parameterValues},next_trigger_time=#{schedule.nextTriggerTime},updated_by=#{schedule.updatedBy},revision=revision+1,update_time=NOW() WHERE task_id=#{schedule.taskId} AND revision=#{expectedRevision}
UPDATE sql_task_schedule SET last_trigger_time=#{expectedTrigger},next_trigger_time=#{nextTrigger},update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND enabled=1 AND next_trigger_time=#{expectedTrigger}
